title: Advancing next-generation proton exchange membrane fuel cell design through multi-physics and AI modeling
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,126-149
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04599A, Perspective
Guobin Zhang, Zhiguo Qu, Qiang Zheng, Yichen Zhou, Ning Wang, Yun Wang
This Perspective identifies key challenges and opportunities of three-dimensional multi-physics and artificial intelligence modeling for predictive temporal multi-physics distribution, aiming to advance the development of next-generation fuel cells.
